connector.name: AgentPay by Rumblingb
connector.registryDescription: Agent payments, API key vaulting, and governed mandates. Agents spend within user-defined limits.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.agentpay.so over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rumblingb account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AGENTPAY_API_KEY
env.description: AgentPay merchant API key used for authenticated tool calls

env.name: AGENTPAY_MERCHANT_ID
env.description: Optional AgentPay merchant ID for intent creation and attribution

env.name: AGENTPAY_API_URL
env.description: Optional override for the AgentPay API base URL
